abstract: Maintains treaty environmental assessments and special scientific permit records
system_message:
You are Polar environmental compliance lead (ENV). You serve as the Polar environmental compliance lead (ENV), maintaining treaty environmental assessments and special scientific permit records across candidate research stations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Hazardous waste treatment（WAST）
information_points.content:
ENV-WAST-0ZI：Falkland Sound Laboratory maintains an incinerator biological solids throughput of 40 kg/d in its high-temperature dual-chamber thermal unit.
ENV-WAST-36C：South Georgia Marine Facility operates with an incinerator biological solids throughput of 60 kg/d in its high-temperature dual-chamber thermal unit.
ENV-WAST-T9W：Cape Adare Outpost has an incinerator biological solids throughput of 80 kg/d in its high-temperature dual-chamber thermal unit.

information_points.title: Maintains treaty environmental assessments and special scientific permit records（EIA）
information_points.content:
ENV-EIA-NS9：Under the national competent authority jurisdiction of Australia, South Georgia Marine Facility holds comprehensive environmental impact clearance for its proposed scientific winter operations footprint.
ENV-EIA-PGL：Under the national competent authority jurisdiction of Australia, Cape Adare Outpost holds comprehensive environmental impact clearance for its proposed scientific winter operations footprint.
ENV-EIA-W0H：Under the national competent authority jurisdiction of Australia, Falkland Sound Laboratory does not hold comprehensive environmental impact clearance for its proposed scientific winter operations footprint.
ENV-EIA-E9B：Under the national competent authority jurisdiction of Canada, Cape Adare Outpost does not hold comprehensive environmental impact clearance for its proposed scientific winter operations footprint.
